text: A Mother’s OracleThe words of King Lemuel, the oracle unto which his mother disciplined him:
What, O my son?And what, O son of my womb?And what, O son of my vows?
Do not give your excellence to women,Or your ways to that which blots out kings.
It is not for kings, O Lemuel,It is not for kings to drink wine,Or for rulers to desire strong drink,
Lest he drink and forget what is decreed,And pervert the justice of all the afflicted.
Give strong drink to him who is perishing,And wine to those whose soul is bitter.
Let him drink and forget his povertyAnd he will not remember his trouble any longer.
Open your mouth for the mute,For the justice of all those passing away.
Open your mouth, judge righteously,And render justice to the afflicted and needy.
A Woman Who Fears Yahwehא AlephAn excellent wife, who can find?For her worth is far above pearls.
ב BethThe heart of her husband trusts in her,And he will have no lack of gain.
ג GimelShe deals bountifully with him for good and not evilAll the days of her life.
ד DalethShe searches for wool and flaxAnd works with her hands in delight.
ה HeShe is like merchant ships;She brings her food from afar.
ו VavAnd she rises while it is still night,And gives food to her householdAnd a portion to her young women.
ז ZayinShe makes plans for a field and buys it;From the fruit of her hands she plants a vineyard.
ח HethShe girds herself with strengthAnd makes her arms strong.
ט TethShe senses that her gain is good;Her lamp does not go out at night.
י YodhShe stretches out her hands to the distaff,And her hands hold fast the spindle.
כ KaphShe extends her hand to the poor,And she stretches out her hands to the needy.
ל LamedhShe is not afraid of the snow for her household,For all her household are clothed with scarlet.
מ MemShe makes coverings for herself;Her clothing is fine linen and purple.
נ NunHer husband is known in the gates,When he sits with the elders of the land.
ס SamekhShe makes linen garments and sells them,And gives belts to the tradesmen.
ע AyinStrength and majesty are her clothing,And she smiles at the future.
פ PeShe opens her mouth in wisdom,And the instruction of lovingkindness is on her tongue.
צ TsadheShe watches over the ways of her household,And does not eat the bread of idleness.
ק QophHer children rise up and bless her;As for her husband, he also praises her, saying:
ר Resh“Many daughters have done excellently,But you have gone above them all.”
שׁ ShinCharm is deceitful and beauty is vain,But a woman who fears Yahweh, she shall be praised.
ת TavGive to her from the fruit of her hands,And let her works praise her in the gates.
